changelog:
Initial release of Infinimo AI Design image generation skill.

- Generate AI images via Infinimo AI Design API with model, aspect ratio, and resolution selection.
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, reference (multi-image) based, and e-commerce creative generation.
- Includes endpoints for model/ratio/size info, reference uploads (up to 12), job submission, and polling for results.
- Credentials are read from environment (`INFINIMO_TOKEN` / `INFINIMO_API_KEY`) or requested from user; never hardcoded.
- Step-by-step workflow and API usage documented for easy integration.
summary: Generate AI images via the Infinimo AI Design API—model/aspect/resolution selection, reference uploads, job submission, and result polling. Use for text-to-image, image-to-image, e-commerce creatives, and reference-based generation.
